### Opening hours Pinakothek der Moderne 21.11.2026

Dear visitors,  
Due to an internal event, the Pinakothek der Moderne will close at 1 p.m. on Saturday, 21 November.  
We thank you for your understanding.

## Information for your visit

### How to find us

![](https://4264.cdn.cke-cs.com/TShhe4UyAuVeQnco10LJ/images/5782cda0b66652540ef541fa1572dae95489b2708b3ec135.jpg)

Our [map (PDF)](https://www.pinakothek.de/media/6729/download/BSTGS_Lageplan_241022.jpg?v=1 "Lageplan der Pinakotheken") gives you an overview of the different ways to reach us.

Alte Pinakothek  
Barer Strasse 27  
(Entrance Theresienstrasse)  
80333 Munich

You can reach the Alte Pinakothek by:

Tram  
Line 27 | 28: Stop Pinakotheken

Underground  
U2: Stop Königsplatz or Theresienstrasse  
U3 | U6: Odeonsplatz or Universität  
U4 | U5: Odeonsplatz

Bus  
Line 100 (museum line) | Line 58 (CityRing) : Stop Pinakotheken

We recommend travelling by public transport, as there are no parking spaces available in the immediate vicinity of the museums.
